pages.text: $(l)Multiblocks$()$(li)When building the Twelve Gates of Heaven, ensure the single leg points $(o)outward$() from the Font, not inward; building it backwards prevents impetus hatches from connecting.

$(l)Fluids$()$(li)To automate fluid passive crafting, use export buses on a shared subnet for each fluid, or manually transport fluids if automation is unavailable.$(li)For the Definer, use crafting cards and melters to input all fluids—no need for complex fluid networks;
this avoids power and throughput issues.$(li)In the heat exchanger, mineral water coolant must flow opposite to hot nak; this is critical for correct operation.

$(l)Automation$()$(li)The Extreme Crafting Table cannot be automated with Automation Interfaces; use packagers instead (e.g., 6 for Gems of Aura).$(li)A single salt repolarizer is insufficient for 16 two-phase machines; use at least two to keep them running continuously.

$(li)For the alchemical particle multiblock, use a dedicated subnet powered by a creative cell on red, with a blue storage bus on a fading matter interface (512 max), and a red storage bus reading the interface connected to ME input set to 100,000.
